_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. fingerprint.com declares its design-token layer in the marketing site's stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): the FPDS channel-triplet palette under fpds.*, its resolved --color-* hex ramp under color.*, the Tailwind type/space/radius/container/shadow/ease scales under core.*, and the semantic --color-primary/-border/-surface-raised roles under light.*. The dark set holds only the 11 .dark-scoped syntax redeclarations — the site ships no dark theme, so they are declared values, not a painted page theme. Measured roles alias the declared values they match.

sans.description: Inter — every heading, control and body on the marketing site; hashed family name plus Arial/system fallbacks.

serif.description: Petrona — the serif display face used on editorial sections; Times New Roman/Georgia fallback.

mono.description: JetBrains Mono — code, prompts and signal values; Courier New/monospace fallback.

pixel.description: Geist Pixel — the pixel display face; ui-monospace fallback.
